'''''Corellian Thunder''''' was a [[Ghtroc Industries/Legends|Ghtroc Industries]] [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]] owned and operated by the [[Corellian/Legends|Corellian]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] [[Davrin]]. The freighter was sent to pick up professional [[Scoundrel/Legends|thief]] [[Sienn Sconn]] from [[Rydonni Prime]].<ref name="Easy">{{JournalCite|9|Easy Credits}}</ref>
